defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) (Data Abstraction Layer guides and reference) plus the Shopware 6.7 source, retrieved 2026-08-20.

entity.title: Shopware DAL entities
entity.description: Shopware DAL entities: EntityDefinition, entity class, collection, repository, extensions, versioning, indexers, custom entities. Use when the request names a Shopware entity or EntityDefinition.
entity.intro: An entity is three classes plus a definition. The core reference lists all 312 shipped entities.

fields.title: Shopware DAL fields and associations
fields.description: Shopware DAL fields: field types, flags, inheritance, serializers, custom fields, translations, all four association kinds. Use when the request names a Shopware field type or association.
fields.intro: What a definition is made of. Associations come in four shapes and each needs a specific field pair.

query.title: Shopware DAL queries
query.description: Shopware DAL queries: the Criteria API, filters, sorting, aggregations, and when plain SQL beats the DAL. Use when the request names a Shopware Criteria, DAL filter or aggregation.
query.intro: Reading data. Criteria is the single entry point; filters, sorting and aggregations are its parts.

write.title: Shopware DAL writes and migrations
write.description: Shopware DAL writes: write events and their payloads, database migrations. Use when the request names a Shopware write event or database migration.
write.intro: Changing data and changing schema. Write events fire around every persist and are the hook for side effects.
